This matter is taken up through Hybrid Mode.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the Petitioners submitted that  on 08.04.2013, Opposite Party No.2 lodged a written report in  Kakiriguma Police Station regarding unnatural death of his daughter  and on his report Kakiriguma Police registered a U.D. Case  No.01/2012 on 08.04.2012 and the enquiring officer ascertained  that the death of the deceased was due to failure of love relationship  with one Chakadola Bisoi and on the report of the enquiring officer,
 Kakiriguma P.S. Case No.17 was registered on 25.05.2012 under Section 306 of IPC against accused Chakadola Bisoi @ Kaka and in  that case cognizance under Section 306 of IPC has already been  taken by the learned J.M.F.C., Laxmipur.

He further submitted that  the complaint in 1.C.C. Case No.07/2013 Dharmaraj Subudhi (the  father of the deceased) has falsely created a new story with an  intention to put the petitioners in trouble and filed one complaint  Page 1 of 4  case before the learned J.M.F.C., Laxmipur alleging commission of rape and murder by the petitioners.
2.1.

Challenging the order dated 10.04.2025 passed by the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Koraput in Criminal Revision No.02 of 2018 (Revision against the order dated 08.04.2015 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Laxmipur in 1.C.C. 07/2013), wherein the revision petition was dismissed, the Petitioners have approached this Court by way of filing this application under Section Khagendra Bisoi And Another vs State Of Orissa And Another .... ...

3. Issue notice to the Opposite Parties.
4.

Since Mr. Udit Ranjan Jena, learned Additional Government Advocate appears and waives issue of notice on behalf of Opposite Party No.1, learned counsel appearing for the Petitioners is requested to serve extra copy of this application on him by tomorrow.
5. Issue notice to Opposite Party No.2 by Registered Post/Speed Post with A.D., requisites for which shall be filed by tomorrow (04.06.2025).

In the event of furnishing such requisites by the said date,
the Office shall send the notice to the said Opposite Party by fixing a short returnable date.

6. List this matter in the week commencing 28th July, 2025.
7.

It is submitted that while rejecting the revision petition, the learned Additional Sessions Judge,
Koraput has directed the accused persons to appear before the learned J.M.F.C., Laxmipur.

It is brought to the notice of this Court by filing copy of order dated 12.05.2025 in 1.C.C. 07 of 2013 forming part of this Interlocutory Application (Annexure-7), that:
"The informant is present.
Accused persons are absent.
Advocate for the accused persons has filed a petition praying for time on the grounds stated therein.
Perused the order of Hon'ble Additional Sessions Judge, Koraput in Criminal Revision 02/2018.
It has been directed to the accused persons therein that, they have to appear on 12.05.2025 without fail to receive the instructions for further progress in the case.
Accordingly the petition filed devoids of any merit and stands rejected.

Issue NBWA against the accused persons fixing case to 08.09.2025 for production."
8.

Learned counsel appearing for the Petitioners submitted that a petition for adjournment was sought for before the learned J.M.F.C. on the ground that the Petitioners have challenged the order in revision before this Court in the afore-noted CRLMC, which is pending.
Nonetheless, the learned J.M.F.C. rejecting the time petition, has issued Non-Bailable Warrants of Arrest.
9. On perusal of Annexures-1 & 3, it is reported that the death was occurred due to taking excess Chloroqueen Tablets.
Therefore, the accused person could not have been implicated on charges of rape under Section 376(g) of the Indian Penal Code.
10. Since notice has been issued in the CRLMC, it is deemed appropriate for grant of stay of execution of NBW pursuant to order dated 12.05.2025 till the next date.

(M.S. Raman) Vacation Judge Laxmikant Signed by: LAXMIKANT MOHAPATRA Designation:
